data.body: CORRECTED DIAGNOSIS (2026-06-05, investigation): The ticket diagnosis ("test-harness gap — add a get_comments stub to FakeAcliClient") is a RED HERRING and does NOT fix the failure. Verified on HEAD: (1) applier._apply_inbound_create now wraps client.get_comments in try/except Exception (applier.py:843-857), so the AttributeError is CAUGHT and logged as a warning — it is a symptom, not the cause. (2) After adding a get_comments()->[] stub the test STILL FAILS: mapping.json is never written. REAL ROOT CAUSE: a brand-new key diffs to a typed Mutation(direction=inbound, action=create, target=uuid-X, local_id=None) (differ.py:447) and routes to _apply_inbound_create, which — unlike the outbound create_one (applier.py:2004-2029) — has NO dedup guard: it never searches for a pre-existing dso-id:<id> label, never writes bridge_state/mapping.json, and never emits the dedup-create-skipped manifest event the test asserts (test docstring + assertions 3b/3c). So this is a PRODUCTION defect (missing inbound-create dedup symmetry), not a test gap. NUANCE/RISK before fixing: the test keys the dedup on the mutation TARGET (uuid-X) — search dso-id:uuid-X, mapping[uuid-X]=PROJ-999 — but for a real inbound create target is a Jira key (e.g. DIG-1234), and dso-id labels store the LOCAL id, so dso-id:<jira-key> would not normally match; the correct inbound dedup key/semantics need a deciding call. Also: mirroring create_one adds one Jira search per inbound create (perf: f6cc comment #8 notes ~2050 inbound creates in prod). Recommended fix: add an inbound dedup guard mirroring create_one (skip-create + _write_mapping_atomic + dedup-create-skipped event), with the dedup key resolved correctly for production inbound semantics. Dedup candidates b38a/38fd/4cc1 share this exact defect; 4cc1 ALSO carries a separate order-dependent flaky test (test_fetcher_dedup_observable.py::test_dedup_suppression_emits_alert) — distinct issue.
